static_traits.name: Liu Kai
static_traits.occupation: Fast-food Chef at a local restaurant
static_traits.social_status: Has a few friends to talk with, but hard to open one's heart to them
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; have not received psychotherapy before; no similar writing-related problems before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, fair cooperativeness, neutral tone; tending to focus on negative feedback, with Self-doubt and catastrophizing tendencies

basic_info.main_problem: Feeling Anxiety and inferiority because the publisher went bankrupt, believing it was because my books were unpopular, constantly doubting my writing ability, feeling like a failure.
basic_info.core_demands: Realizing negative thoughts and Self-doubt are affecting mental health and blocking my writing career, thus seeking counseling to lessen these effects.

core_beliefs: I am not suited to be a Writer
No one wants to buy my books

special_situations.event: Learning the publisher is about to close
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my writing were good enough to sell, the publisher would not have gone bankrupt; the publisher's business outcome is directly related to my work's quality
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Increasing self-pressure, trying to improve writing skill and seeking beta-reader feedback to prove myself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It is all my fault; my books are not good enough

special_situations.event: Receives mixed feedback, of which the negative feedback concerns him more
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If someone raises negative opinions, it means I am not suited to writing; negative feedback is more 'real' than positive feedback
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Continuously focusing on and magnifying negative reviews, ignoring positive feedback, trying to keep revising to please critics
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are right, I am not good enough

special_situations.event: When writing hits setbacks or the career is blocked
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I fail this time, it means I will never succeed; one failure equals total failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing or stopping writing, sinking into Self-doubt and avoidance
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never become a Writer

special_situations.event: When considering sharing writing struggles with friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I tell friends about my plight, they will not understand and tell me to 'snap out of it' or 'write something else'
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding discussing unsafe topics with friends, staying Silent to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am being melodramatic and will not understand me

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized and understood as a Writer, with works loved by readers and supported
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure and being negated, worrying no one will read my works, being seen as 'not good enough'
defense_goal: Gaining a sense of control and reducing uncertainty through self-criticism and blaming myself
Keeping emotional distance from others, avoiding sharing to reduce the risk of Being rejected or not being understood

object_relations.object_representation: Others/publishers are critical judges who may not understand me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing topics of a publishing house closing or receiving negative feedback
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client internalizes external business failure as inadequate ability, and sees inquiry as a negation of their ability
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using self-blaming and absolutist expressions (like 'It is all my fault'), in a lowered tone, rarely mentioning external factors; emphasizing my own inadequacy.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to consider sharing feelings with friends or seeking support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Subconsciously believing others will reject or blame me like reviewers (not understood / Demanded to 'snap out of it')
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Describes others' negative intentions in hypothetical language (such as 'they will make me get myself together quickly'), hesitant tone, avoiding concrete requests for help.

manifestations: Feeling 'this is meaningless' when sitting down to write, believing no one will want to read my works
outcomes: Decreased drive for writing and lower productivity

manifestations: Feeling friends will not understand my writing plight, struggling to ask for help
outcomes: Social withdrawal and increased sense of isolation
Insufficient mobilization of the support system, negative thought cycle maintained

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Assuming friends will tell me to 'snap out of it / write something else', thus avoiding sharing
Inferring others will not understand me without verification

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: Frequent Self-denial (like 'I am not good enough' 'I am not suited to writing')
Over-restricts self-expression and reduces help-seeking for fear of being evaluated

positive_force: Has a love for writing, occasionally when writing something can experience pride
Willing to try improving writing and to seek beta-reader feedback
Work performance stable, basic life functions not yet affected
Willing to try setting smaller, achievable writing goals
Having a few friends, potential support resources present
negative_force: Marked cognitive biases like catastrophizing, overgeneralization, personalization, negating positive feedback
Avoiding sharing plights with friends, insufficient support-system mobilization
High stress and self-pressure, a belief pattern of total negation upon failure
Emotional reasoning while writing (feeling bad and concluding things are bad) leads to avoidance and stagnation

target_behavior.behavior: Writing avoidance and low productivity (hard to start or persist when sitting down to write)
antecedent: The moment of sitting down to write
target_behavior.core_reason: Personalizing and catastrophizing external events, internalizing them as the core belief 'I am not good enough', generating Anxiety and Meaninglessness that lead to avoiding writing
target_behavior.function: Escaping potential failure and being negated, gaining short-term emotional relief
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased writing productivity, blocked Career development, worsening Meaninglessness and inferiority

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance(not sharing writing plights with friends)
antecedent: When thinking about discussing writing difficulties with friends
Facing situations where seeking support is advised
target_behavior.core_reason: Mind-reading assumptions that others will not understand and will blame me, fearing negation and shame
target_behavior.function: Avoids potential rejection and embarrassment, maintaining short-term safety
target_behavior.consequence: Missing Social support, Increased sense of isolation, ongoing cycle of negative thinking and Self-doubt
